title: install-ops-bullet-log
content:
Daily field ops scratchpad — quick run log and TODOs

Context:
- Customer: Acadia Health (pilot) — non-prod cluster in customer VPC (eu-west-1)
- Goal: finish infra bootstrap + secure KMS handshake + smoke tests by EOD
- Team patch: Maya on site (remote tunnel), Liam remote SRE, Priya lead install engineer

Morning goals (quick):
- (#1) Get bastion -> control plane SSH stable (keepalive tweak)
- (#2) Finish terraform apply for data-plane subnets (confirm route tables)
- (#3) Validate KMS key access from control plane nodes (test decrypt)

Quick checklist (progress flags)
- [x] Confirmed circuit and physical rack power sequencing with customer (09:10)
- [x] Created ephemeral jump host (t2.large) for install tunnel
- [x] Uploaded certs to secure bucket (temp creds)
- [ ] Finish terraform apply for az-2 (stuck on IGW binding)
- [ ] Run full e2e smoke (expected ~20m)

Commands & snippets run today (notes to self)
- ssh -i ~/.ssh/maya_acadia.pem ec2-user@bastion-eu-west1
- terraform workspace select acadia-pilot && terraform apply -var-file=eu-west-1.tfvars
- aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://enc-key.bin --profile acadia
- docker run --rm -v /var/tmp:/out redwood/inference-smoke:latest /out/report.json
- rsync -avz -e "ssh -i key" local/scripts/ ec2-user@bastion:/tmp/deploy-scripts/

Network / VPC specific observations:
- Route table for data-subnet-2 lacked a 0.0.0.0/0 to the NAT; terraform plan showed a replacement (why drift?). Possible manual route created earlier by NetOps — left a note in ticket
- Customer ACLs: ephemeral port range 32000-33000 is closed by default; we need to request a short-lived exception for KV cache warmup
- DNS: private hosted zone delegated but missing NS entry in parent zone for az-2. If not fixed, model artifact fetch fails intermittently

Blockers and mitigation ideas:
- BLOCKER: IGW binding for az-2 failing due to conflicting tag on attachment (cloud team had nonstandard tag). Workaround: patch terraform to ignore_tags on attachment resource and reapply; longer-term: ask cloud team to remove tag. (Opened JIRA: JIRA-PI-4590)
- BLOCKER: KMS policy denies decrypt for control-plane role when key was created from console. Mitigation: add explicit kms:Decrypt for role ARN and re-run bootstrap script. ACL sync queued with Priya.
- Temp workaround: create a local encrypted secret (symmetric) for bootstrap then rotate to KMS after control-plane IAM resolved. Not ideal, document in postmortem

Customer env reminders (notes for next visits):
- Customer login: svc-acadia-deploy (expires monthly). Remind them to rotate 02/20
- Rack: unit U23 has legacy switch stacked; avoid power cycle 2 and 3 simultaneously
- Their proxy terminates TLS for outbound; add redwood-internal.ca to allowed SAN list, otherwise model downloads hit 403

Action items (assignments)
- Maya: patch terraform to ignore problematic tag & attempt reapply (ETA 2h)
- Priya: update KMS key policy + confirm IAM role ARN (blocker ticket) (ETA 1h)
- Liam: schedule short window with NetOps to open ephemeral range 32000-33000 (ETA today 14:00)
- Maya/Priya: run smoke test after apply, collect token-level latency sample, push to /tmp/smoke-report.json and upload to confluence page link in linked_artifacts

Unresolved questions / things to document later:
- Why did terraform drift for route? check if a customer process reconciles routes nightly (cron) — ask NetOps for their automation list
- Should we default to creating our own hosted zone instead of delegating? Pros/cons to list for post-pilot decision

Quick wins to reduce friction next time:
- Add a preflight script to validate hosted zone delegation + NS before any terraform apply
- Create a short KMS policy template for console-created keys to avoid missing ARNs
- Ship a small network diagram (handdrawn) for each site in onboarding checklist

End-of-day quick status (to fill after tasks):
- IGW reattach: [ ]
- Terraform az-2 apply: [ ]
- KMS decrypt test: [ ]
- Smoke test pass: [ ]

Random notes / scratch ideas:
- Could use a tiny Lambda in customer account to run ephemeral route checks and report to our console; lighter than requiring NetOps intervention each time
- Consider a short-runbook: "If KMS denies decrypt" with 3 steps (check role ARN, check key policy, create ephemeral secret). Put in KB

Timestamp: 2025-02-13 09:05 UTC — saving current state before heading into the tunnel
summary: Personal install ops scratchpad for private deploy pilot: bastion/terraform/KMS blockers and next steps
